changes.title: The control code is the status
changes.text: Identifier chip: the code in monospace inside a round pill tinted by status, glyph in front. A register drops its status column; used only where the status varies on the page.
changes.drata: Drata puts the control code in a tinted pill, green with a check when ready, pink with a crossed circle when not.

changes.title: One header shape on every record
changes.text: Trail, id chip before a 26px title, then ⋯, secondary, primary at the right; a facts strip of label-over-value pairs with a pencil where editable; line tabs under it.
changes.drata: Every Drata record opens on the same header: crumb, identifier chip, title, actions, a facts row and tabs.

changes.title: Tabs count problems, not sizes
changes.text: A tab's problem count is a pale red badge; a plain count is grey; a tab with nothing wrong shows nothing.
changes.drata: Drata shows Monitoring 1 or Policies 3 as pale red counts on a control's tabs.

changes.title: Readiness as a readable sum
changes.text: A slim bar (judged of objectives) whose tooltip breaks the total down, over four stage cards: a state word after a tinted glyph, a legend of counts, or one line and an outlined verb.
changes.drata: Drata's control page shows a 6 of 11 bar with a breakdown tooltip and four readiness cards.

changes.title: Plain stat tiles, one loud
changes.text: Four equal tiles, a label over a 32px ink figure. Only a problem tile leads with a warning glyph; nothing else is coloured.
changes.drata: Drata's overview tiles are a label over a big number; a problem tile carries the warning mark.

changes.title: Track, Fix, Manage on a record
changes.text: Three tiles: a label, the metric, a big figure in its tone, a since line and the link that works it (history, findings, POA&M).
changes.drata: Drata's test page opens on Days failed, Failing resources and Tickets in progress, each with its link.

changes.title: A source says what it is worth
changes.text: A row of count links, 167 objectives · 43 controls · 20 components; each opens its list.
changes.drata: Drata's integration cards say how many impact areas, controls and tests a connection covers.

changes.title: Filter panel beside the table
changes.text: A 280px card of collapsible groups, each with its applied count and option counts. The toolbar's Filter button opens and closes it; closed by default under 1180px.
changes.drata: Drata's long lists sit beside a filter panel with radio and checkbox groups and a Filters applied row.

changes.title: Floating selection bar
changes.text: Chosen rows raise a bar at the foot of the window: N selected · Select all M, the verbs as text buttons, and Clear.
changes.drata: Drata floats 50 selected · Select all 1379 with the bulk verbs at the bottom of the list.

changes.title: A preview you can walk
changes.text: The preview's top row reads 2 of 10 with Previous ↑, Next ↓ and ✕; then status, title, Open and facts. Arrow keys walk the list in its order.
changes.drata: Drata's evidence preview pages through the list with Previous and Next beside a counter.

changes.title: Panes dock, the page narrows
changes.text: A 40px rail of icon buttons at the record's right edge; a pane docks at 380px and the main column narrows. At 390 the rail is a row of icons.
changes.drata: Drata's control utilities rail opens Notes, Tickets and Tasks beside the page.

changes.title: Each card owns its Edit
changes.text: Edit on a card swaps its facts for inputs; Save (small, solid) and Cancel under them; Save keeps the values and redraws only that card.
changes.drata: Drata edits a control's Info section in place with its own Save and Cancel.

changes.title: A sunken page, raised cards
changes.text: Record and overview bodies sit in a grey well with white bordered cards, radius 10px. Registers stay one surface.
changes.drata: Drata's newer pages put white cards on a grey page; lists stay flat.

changes.title: A flow with a vertical stepper
changes.text: Back link, title, a vertical stepper (done filled with a check, current a ring, later grey), a form column about 880px wide, Back left and the primary right.
changes.drata: Drata's long setup flows put a vertical stepper at the left of the form.

changes.title: A validation sheet before import
changes.text: Imported rows in a compact grid: red cells block with their message on hover, amber cells warn; a segmented All · Valid · Invalid control filters the rows.
changes.drata: Drata's import sheet marks invalid cells red, warnings yellow, with All, Valid and Invalid counts.

changes.title: Show what will change first
changes.text: A short table of counted rows, locked rows ticked and disabled, then Moving N · Not moving M and one consequence line.
changes.drata: Drata shows counts before a bulk command and keeps required groups locked.

changes.title: Compare back to the template
changes.text: A dialog of three columns, Current, Template, Selections; differences tinted (current pale red, template pale green); each changed field is one switch, Keep current or Use template, with Use template for all at the top.
changes.drata: Drata's Compare with template shows current against the template with Apply or Reject per field.

changes.title: AI suggests, with its reasons
changes.text: A card marked AI (the prototype's sparkle in the brand tint), a confidence word, the suggestion, one rationale line, its source in grey, then Map and Dismiss with Undo.
changes.drata: Drata's mapping agent shows each recommendation with a confidence level and a rationale.

changes.title: An agent's proposal ends in a sign
changes.text: A bordered card: one bold line naming the change, a collapsed Why, then Approve and Decline. Approve is filled only when it is the page's one primary; otherwise it is a secondary and Decline a quiet text button.
changes.drata: Drata's agent ends its answer in an action card with Approve and Decline.

changes.title: The open pane is in the address
changes.text: A page dock writes its open pane into the address as --dock-notes, with no history entry. The link opens with Notes docked; closing takes the suffix off. Lanes change nothing.
changes.drata: Drata keeps a record's utility pane open beside the page; we also keep it in the link, as Ledger's addresses hold every view.

changes.title: Every preview walks its list
changes.text: Where a lane gave no order, the preview walks the rows of the list it was opened from, in their drawn order: 2 of 9, Previous, Next and the arrow keys.
changes.drata: Drata's preview pages through whatever list it was opened from, with a counter and Previous and Next.

components.used: dr-controls rows, dr-control--<code> header, dr-evidence controls, dr-finding--<id>
every after record: control, evidence, source, check, finding

derived: Every demo reads WS-X90's controls from PA.SSP (codes, titles, statuses, objectives mapped, evidenced and judged); the stage and tab demos use the first control in catalog order that is part way along (AC-3(4) style), so the choice is deterministic.

Track · Fix · Manage reads the first failing check from V3's checks (name, failing count, due date); days failing is the days from its due date to the prototype's clock (2026-11-17). POA&M items in progress is 0: the prototype records none on that check.

What a source is worth counts WS-X90's CM-family controls and their objectives as what an ACAS feed could evidence, and its components from the system tree's LRUs; the feed's real coverage is not in the prototype.

The sheet, steps, moving, compare, suggest, proposal and dock demos use short illustrative rows (an SCTM import, CM-8 against its library implementation, REQ-112 to SI-2(2), notes and tasks) written for the demo; they name real controls and are not saved as records.
Inherited takes the info blue (--info, --info-soft), the hue the prototype uses beside ok/warn/bad for a status that is not the program's own; V3 has no separate inherited token.
conflicts: Filter panel (rec 21) against the one-row toolbar: the toolbar row stays; D.facetToggle sits in K.toolbar's right and opens and closes the panel beside the table; there is no Filters applied chip row, and Clear all lives in the panel's header.

Drata's pink crossed-circle Not ready against our ladder: the chip takes the ladder's tone (satisfied green, not assessed and partial amber, other than satisfied red, no requirement and no evidence neutral grey), so an absence stays silent.
Drata's blue-outlined secondaries: the outlined small action on an empty stage and Decline use a neutral grey outline, and the selection bar's verbs are text buttons.
Drata's drawer has its own chrome; ours sits in V3's preview panel (#panel): the panel's bar is hidden while a drawer shows and the drawer's top row carries the position, Previous, Next and ✕.
The gallery shows one header per demo, so it holds more than one primary on a page; every after screen keeps one primary.
Drata's docked panes count their items on the rail; we keep a small grey count on the rail icons (not in the menu), never a red badge.

added.text: The dock's open pane is in the address: this link opens the finding with Notes docked.
A preview walks the list it was opened from, even where its lane gave no order.
